*   **Dark Edge Artifacts:** Using bounded sampling (like BBSplat) with standard 2DGS opacity causes dark edge artifacts because color decays from the center.
*   **2D Texture-Based Volume Rendering:** Maps 2D textures onto volume primitives.
Differs by using direct bilinear interpolation with border clamping rather than other mapping strategies.
Choose when smooth texture transitions across primitive boundaries are required. [Link](916-2d-texture-based-volume-rendering.md)
*   **Palette Texture Volume Rendering:** Uses palette index lookup for color mapping.
Differs by avoiding direct color interpolation in favor of quantized palette access.
Choose when memory bandwidth is limited or color quantization is desired. [Link](6502-palette-texture-volume-rendering.md)
*   **Cabral Texture Mapping:** Applies Cabral's geometric mapping approach.
Differs by using a different coordinate transformation and sampling logic compared to the bilinear border-clamping approach.
Choose when specific geometric mapping properties of Cabral's method are required. [Link](7257-cabral-texture-mapping.md)
*   **Wall Surface Projection & Texture Mapping:** Projects textures onto planar wall-like surfaces.
Differs by focusing on planar projection rather than primitive-local bilinear sampling.
Choose for architectural or planar scene reconstruction. [Link](9883-wall-surface-projection-texture-mapping.md)

*   **Adapted Coordinate Texture (ACT) Module:** Adapts coordinate systems for texture mapping.
Differs by dynamically adjusting coordinates rather than using fixed local-to-pixel transformation.
Choose when coordinate adaptation is required for specific geometries. [Link](19576-adapted-coordinate-texture-act-module.md)
*   **Projective Texture Mapping:** Maps textures using projective geometry.
Differs by applying projective transformations rather than affine local-to-pixel scaling.
Choose when perspective-correct projection is necessary. [Link](19668-projective-texture-mapping.md)
